footnote_text: The restricted stock units ("RSUs") were granted on October 2, 2026 in connection with the consummation of the disposition of Ekso Bionics, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of ChronoScale Holdings Corporation (the "Issuer"), and vested in full on the grant date. Effective as of October 3, 2026, the Reporting Person resigned as a member of the board of directors of the Issuer. Each RSU represents the right to receive one share of common stock of the Issuer and has no expiration date. || Settlement of the RSUs has been deferred in accordance with the terms of the award agreement.
